answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the violet of a task receipt, and the grove is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The cedar of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
